## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and trust boundaries changed.

## Security Review

- [ ] Authentication, authorization, and object ownership were considered.
- [ ] Inputs, outputs, database operations, file operations, and logs were reviewed.
- [ ] Failure and concurrent-state behavior is explicit.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has positive and negative regression tests.
- [ ] OpenAPI, migrations, threat model, requirements, and runbooks were updated if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, Terraform state, or mutable deployment references were added.
- [ ] Scanner findings are fixed or reference an approved, unexpired exception.

## Evidence

List test commands, relevant results, and manual validation performed.
